zh: 听说老板最近又裁了一个人。
en: Word is the boss just laid off someone again.

zh: 天呐，我们是不是也有可能被裁？
en: Oh no... could we be next?

zh: 都别慌，专心干活，效率给我提上去！
en: Everyone stay calm and focus—let's pick up the pace!

zh: 唉，人心惶惶的，活都没心思干了。
en: Ugh, everyone's on edge, no one can focus on work.

zh: 这周的方案又被客户打回来了。
en: The client bounced our proposal again this week.

zh: 老板脸都黑了，这可怎么办。
en: The boss looks furious. What now?

zh: 慢工出细活，先把质量提上去。
en: Slow down and get the quality right first.

zh: 先冲数量，把进度赶回来。
en: Push the volume and catch up on schedule.

zh: 组长说这周末又要加班赶进度。
en: Team lead says we're working this weekend again.

zh: 唉，周末又没了……
en: There goes another weekend…

zh: 加班餐管够，辛苦大家冲一波！
en: Meals on me—let's power through

zh: 身体要紧，周末好好休息。
en: Health first—take the weekend to rest.

zh: HR 说下周组织团建去爬山。
en: HR's planning a team hike next week.

zh: 团建算加班吗……
en: Does team building count as overtime…?

zh: 放松一下，团建当天不干活！
en: Let's unwind—no work on team-building day!

zh: 团建改成聚餐吧，吃顿好的。
en: Let's make it a group dinner instead—good food for all.

zh: 听说明年可能会涨薪？
en: Heard we might get a raise next year?

zh: 别信，年年都这么说。
en: Don't believe it, they say that every year.

zh: 好好干，年底我一定帮你们争取。
en: Work hard—I'll fight for your raises at year-end.

zh: 涨薪不好说，但奖金我尽量。
en: Raises are uncertain, but I'll push for bonuses.

zh: 办公室空调又坏了，热死了。
en: The office AC broke again, it's boiling.

zh: 这大夏天的没法干活啊。
en: No way to work in this heat.

zh: 我去催维修，先发冰镇饮料降降温。
en: I'll rush the repair—cold drinks on me for now.

zh: 太热就别硬撑，休息为主。
en: Don't push it in this heat—rest up.

zh: 楼下新开了奶茶店，好想喝。
en: New bubble tea shop downstairs, I'm craving it.

zh: 老板请客不过分吧？
en: Treating us wouldn't be too much to ask

zh: 今天下午茶我请，都点起来！
en: Afternoon tea's on me—order away!

zh: 喝奶茶可以，但方案今天得交。
en: Tea's fine, but the proposal ships today.

zh: 刚有人上班刷剧被看到了。
en: Someone got caught streaming shows on the clock.

zh: 完了，要挨批了。
en: We're in for a lecture now.

zh: 偶尔放松可以，但别太过分。
en: A little break is fine, just don't overdo it.

zh: 上班就得专注，都收收心。
en: Focus during work hours—heads back in the game.

zh: 老板又开始讲愿景了。
en: The boss is off on another vision speech.

zh: 又是「我们是一家人」……
en: 'We're all a family' again…

zh: 跟着公司好好干，未来可期！
en: Stick with the company—the future's bright!

zh: 画饼听听就好，活照干。
en: Take the pep talk lightly, just keep working.

zh: 隔壁工位今天提离职了。
en: The person next to me just quit today.

zh: 他的活是不是要分给我们……
en: Are we splitting his workload now…?

zh: 他的工作我来重新分配，别担心。
en: I'll redistribute his work—don't worry.

zh: 人手补上前先扛一阵。
en: Let's tough it out until we backfill.

zh: 今天新来了个实习生。
en: A new intern joined today.

zh: 又要带新人了，头大。
en: Gotta train a newbie again, ugh.

zh: 带新人也是锻炼，耐心点。
en: Mentoring builds you up too—be patient.

zh: 让新人先自己熟悉，别耽误进度。
en: Let the newbie ramp up solo—don't lose momentum.

zh: 这季度 KPI 又涨了 20%。
en: This quarter's KPI went up another 20%.

zh: 这根本完不成啊……
en: There's no way to hit that…

zh: 目标高点是好事，冲一冲！
en: A higher bar is a good thing—go for it!

zh: KPI 我去帮你们谈谈，别太焦虑。
en: I'll negotiate the KPI—don't stress too much.

zh: 客户发邮件表扬我们做得好！
en: The client emailed to praise our work!

zh: 总算被认可了一次。
en: Finally, some recognition.

zh: 干得漂亮，继续保持！
en: Great job—keep it up!

zh: 这次奖金我给大家申请。
en: I'll put in for bonuses this time.

zh: 公司 wifi 又卡了，文件传不动。
en: Office wifi's lagging again, can't upload anything.

zh: 这活没法干了。
en: Can't get any work done like this.

zh: 我去让 IT 马上处理。
en: I'll get IT on it right away.

zh: 先用手机热点顶着吧。
en: Just tether off your phones for now.

zh: 明天起每天八点半晨会。
en: Daily 8:30 stand-ups start tomorrow.

zh: 又要早起了，救命。
en: Early mornings again, help.

zh: 晨会同步进度，效率更高。
en: Stand-ups sync us up and boost efficiency.

zh: 晨会改成线上吧，别太折腾。
en: Let's move stand-ups online—less hassle.

zh: 茶水间新装了台咖啡机！
en: New coffee machine in the pantry!

zh: 终于有续命神器了。
en: Finally, some life support.

zh: 咖啡管够，今天多干一点！
en: Unlimited coffee—let's do a bit more today!

zh: 喝咖啡提神，注意别熬夜。
en: Coffee's for a boost—just don't pull all-nighters.

zh: 这次事故上面要找人背锅。
en: Management wants a scapegoat for the incident.

zh: 该不会是我们组吧……
en: Please don't let it be our team…

zh: 责任我来担，你们安心干活。
en: I'll take responsibility—you just focus on work.

zh: 谁的问题谁负责，说清楚。
en: Whoever's at fault owns it—let's be clear.

zh: 我们的项目今天成功上线了！
en: Our project went live today!

zh: 熬了这么多天总算值了。
en: All those late nights finally paid off.

zh: 庆功宴走起，大家辛苦了！
en: Time to celebrate—great work

zh: 趁热打铁，下个项目继续冲！
en: Strike while it's hot—on to the next one!

zh: 听说今年年终奖要打折。
en: Heard the year-end bonus is getting cut.

zh: 忙一整年就这？
en: A whole year of grind for this?

zh: 我去帮大家争取，别灰心。
en: I'll fight for it—don't lose heart.

zh: 今年行情不好，大家理解一下。
en: Tough market this year—please bear with it.

zh: 公司要试行弹性上下班。
en: Company's trialing flexible hours.

zh: 终于不用挤早高峰了！
en: No more rush-hour crush!

zh: 弹性归弹性，活别落下。
en: Flexible hours are fine—just don't fall behind.

zh: 时间自由，状态好了活更细致。
en: Freedom helps—better focus means finer work.
